# SuitcaseSim

> Travel eSIM price comparison. English site. Prices last imported 2026-10-28.

SuitcaseSim compares prepaid travel eSIM plans. It is not the seller. Prices are copied from provider pages or public catalogs and dated.

## Start
- Home: https://suitcasesim.com/
- Japan: https://suitcasesim.com/esim/japan/
- Global: https://suitcasesim.com/esim/global/
- Data calculator: https://suitcasesim.com/tools/data-calculator/
- Methodology: https://suitcasesim.com/methodology/
